title: Echo and Orbit Anew
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Gideon Halloran, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
